program: APPUI-01 - Detailed functional studies inside frozen Phase-1 architecture
question: Can contextual and deep inspection share one reusable grammar across meaningful entity types while preserving semantic origin, disclosure, state distinctions, exact return behavior and responsive collapse without creating a permanent inspector or a new application mode?
inherited_law: Inspectors are contextual capacities, not permanent right-edge requirements.
Meaningful elements are followed from current situation into contextual/deep inspection.
Selection remains distinct from keyboard focus, Director opportunity, fictional salience and Character agency.
Current/historical, provisional/effective, Character/Performer and infrastructure/fiction distinctions remain explicit.
Character-bounded disclosure must not leak creator-global knowledge.
Light and Dark preserve one semantic system; no Stage visual successor is created.

design_result.contextual_role: Answer what matters about the selected entity here; may be adjacent, overlaid, substituted or sequential depending on available space.
design_result.deep_role: Give the same selected entity enough room for broader understanding or creator-authorized shaping while preserving semantic origin and return.
design_result.taxonomy_rule: Witnesses prove shared inspection capacity and are not an exhaustive frozen Product entity taxonomy.
design_result.origin_rule: Deep inspection retains Production/current-Scene/selected-entity origin; Back/Close restores the originating semantic target and focus.
design_result.edit_rule: Exact creator-authority/commit/undo semantics remain Product-defined; inspection may reserve edit capacity without freezing them.
design_result.theme_parity: PASS - Light/Dark use equal specimen weight and preserve identical semantic state
design_result.responsive_rule: wide adjacency -> medium overlay/substitution -> narrow sequential surfaces; semantic origin and return remain invariant

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium CDP; exact self-contained HTML; no external resources

first_visual_pass_findings: Flow arrows were positioned outside four step cards and created four internal overflow witnesses at 1600px even though viewport overflow was false.
The initial Light/Dark comparison used unequal column widths, visually privileging one theme despite the co-equal theme contract.
corrections: Moved flow arrows inside their cards; all five viewport/forced-colors cases now report zero overflow elements.
Changed the Light/Dark comparison to equal 1:1 specimen widths.

non_authority: Exact inspector/deep-surface labels, placements, field groupings and commands remain provisional.
Exact entity taxonomy and persistent data schemas remain Product-defined.
Exact commit/save/undo, Scene lifecycle, consequence review, Perspective switching, Take/Rehearsal/branching, transcript/timer/Pause, provider/model/cost and Performer assignment remain open.
Final typography, palette, materials, icons, motion and native WinUI behavior remain open.
No Stage visual successor, runtime/package/Store authority or native accessibility-device proof is created.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
next: Detail whole-Production Character management inside the frozen shell, including off-Scene reach/edit/return, Scene-membership non-implication, persistent Character identity and Character-versus-Performer separation without creating a permanent People silo.
